hooks.command: d="$(pwd)"; until [ -f "$d/.codex/hooks/fallow-gate.sh" ] || [ -e "$d/.git" ] || [ "$d" = / ]; do d="$(dirname "$d")"; done; if [ -f "$d/.codex/hooks/fallow-gate.sh" ]; then cd "$d" && exec ./.codex/hooks/fallow-gate.sh; fi; exit 0

d="$(pwd)"; until [ -f "$d/.codex/hooks/names-check.sh" ] || [ -e "$d/.git" ] || [ "$d" = / ]; do d="$(dirname "$d")"; done; if [ -f "$d/.codex/hooks/names-check.sh" ]; then cd "$d" && exec ./.codex/hooks/names-check.sh; fi; exit 0
